Share.h2Line2: You decide how to collect leads.
Share.description: Whether you have an advanced website, a simple blog, or a local business – Mulbox adapts to your style.
Share.card1Text: Got a site on WordPress, Elementor, Webflow or Next.js? Paste this short code right into your site's structure. The form works instantly without installing heavy, buggy plugins that overload the database and block email delivery.
Share.card2Text: The ideal solution for the physical world. Download the auto-generated, unique QR code and place it on flyers, restaurant tables, billboards or your company car. Customers scan it with their phone and go straight to the contact form.
Share.card3Text: You don't need your own website or hosting to professionally collect orders. Mulbox creates a ready-made, clean landing page for every form. Copy the generated link and place it in your Instagram, TikTok or LinkedIn bio – or send it straight to the customer in a message.

FAQ.heading: Frequently asked questions
FAQ.q1: How do I make a contact form on WordPress without the Contact Form 7 plugin?
FAQ.a1: Mulbox generates clean HTML code for the form, which you paste into the 'Custom HTML' block in WordPress or Elementor. You don't install any plugin – the form works instantly without burdening the database or PHP.
FAQ.q2: How is Mulbox different from Google Forms and Typeform?
FAQ.a2: Mulbox gives you full control over the look (custom colors, fonts, branding), generates HTML code to embed directly on your site, creates QR codes and standalone landing pages. We don't advertise our brand on your form and don't require a Google account from your customers.
FAQ.q3: Will the emails from the form definitely reach my inbox?
FAQ.a3: Yes. Mulbox sends notifications via Resend with the verified mulbox.ch domain (correct SPF, DKIM and DMARC records). Your address goes into the Reply-To header so you can reply to the customer with one click straight from your own inbox.
FAQ.q4: How much does Mulbox cost and is there a free plan?
FAQ.a4: Mulbox has a free starter plan (no credit card), a Personal plan for 1 PLN/month and a Business plan for 9.90 PLN/month. Business unlocks the autoresponder, custom reCAPTCHA, CSV export and custom redirect after submit.
FAQ.q5: How do I generate a QR code for a local business form?
FAQ.a5: After creating a form in the Mulbox panel you automatically get a QR code that you can download and place on flyers, restaurant tables, billboards or in your car. The customer scans the code with their phone and goes straight to the form.
FAQ.q6: Can I build a form without coding skills?
FAQ.a6: Yes. Mulbox has a visual drag-and-drop builder. You arrange blocks (Name, Email, Phone, Message, files, checkboxes), change colors and design, and copy the generated HTML code with one click.
FAQ.a7: Yes. Data is stored in the European Union (Supabase EU), forms support reCAPTCHA v3, and the user has full control over consent display and the privacy policy. We sign a data processing agreement.
